description:
## Goal

LDPC belief-propagation batch decode kernel on gfx1030 covering
DVB-T2 n=64800 today; the kernel is a flat, standard-agnostic
Tanner-graph decoder so the same kernel binary parameterises both
standards (5G NR BG1 / BG2 in Phase E `23d3525f` via host-side graph
expansion — see the 2026-06-09 shift-table amendment below).

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages) within epic `gf2-sim`
(`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §6 (multi-arch dispatch,
shared kernel binary across BG / lifting set); §8 (OOM signalled,
not dispatched, by this stage); §10 (f32 messages). Wave B.2
fan-out from `36075e4c`. May absorb in-scope tasks from
`epic:hip-gpu-prototype` (`806eb14e`).

Algorithm baselines: BP MinSum / Normalized-MinSum(α) / SumProduct,
matching the CPU `LdpcDecoder` configuration knobs from
`gf2_coding::ldpc::core::DecoderConfig`. Variable-node and
check-node updates run in parallel across the batch; per-iteration
synchronisation via shared memory; deterministic message ordering
(no atomic-add reductions on f32; per-edge ordered accumulation
into a per-edge scratch followed by an ordered reduction).

**AMENDMENT 2026-06-09a (user-approved, apples-to-apples perf baseline).**
The `parallelism-pays` gate compares **decode-stage throughput vs
decode-stage throughput**, NOT GPU-decode vs CPU-full-frame. The
`c0b1702d` (1.6216 fps single-thread) and `3fcb7025` (21.44 fps
24-thread) receipts are FULL-FRAME numbers; using them as the divisor
for a decode-only kernel is category-confused and too lenient — the
same defect that was user-amended on `f6004add`. The gate divisor is
the **CPU `LdpcDecoder` decode stage measured in isolation** (same
DVB-T2 r1/2 16-QAM Normal config, SumProduct, early-termination on,
at Es/N0 = 6.5 dB), at single-thread and 24-thread. Record the
full-frame numbers for context, but gate on decode-vs-decode.

**AMENDMENT 2026-06-09b (user-approved, shift-table consumption is host-side).**
The per-`i_LS` shift table is consumed by the **host-side
`LdpcGraphLayout` builder**, NOT by an in-kernel uniform-buffer
parameter. The GPU kernel is flat and standard-agnostic: it decodes
whatever expanded Tanner graph the host hands it. DVB-T2 is already
fully expanded (no lifting). For 5G NR, the host expands base graph +
per-`i_LS` shift table into the flat `LdpcGraphLayout`, and the SAME
kernel binary decodes it unchanged (design §6 "shared kernel binary
across BG / lifting set"). This avoids an untested in-kernel shift
path (DVB-T2 has no shifts to exercise; the real BG1/BG2 shift tables
do not exist until Phase E `acf9b11a`). **The full per-`i_LS`
criterion is fulfilled later in Phase E `23d3525f`**, which builds the
5G NR flat layout via host-side expansion and proves GPU-vs-CPU
byte-identity on a real lifted code — that obligation is recorded as
a `[hard]` criterion on `23d3525f`. The cosmetic in-kernel
`shift_table`/`shift_len` ABI parameter added in rework-r1 is removed
(it was an accept-and-discard placeholder).

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/hip/ldpc_bp.hip` (flat Tanner-graph kernel;
   sources live in `hip/`, wired into `build.rs`):
   - Decodes the flat (expanded) Tanner-graph layout for any standard;
     DVB-T2 (n=64800, m=32400) today. 5G NR BG1/BG2 reuse the same
     kernel via host-side expansion of base graph + per-`i_LS` shift
     table into the flat layout (Phase E `23d3525f`), so no in-kernel
     shift parameter is needed.
   - Implements MinSum, NormalizedMinSum(α), SumProduct per the
     `DecoderAlgorithm` enum.
   - Maximum BP iterations parameterised; early termination via
     parity-check after each iteration (per-frame freeze matching the
     CPU `decode_to_codeword` first-convergence break).
   - Hard-decision output written to a device buffer.
2. `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/src/launch_ldpc_bp.rs`:
   - `launch_ldpc_bp(stream, layout, llrs, ..., algorithm, max_iters)`
     over the flat `LdpcGraphLayout`.
3. `crates/gf2-sim/src/gpu/ldpc_bp.rs` (under `--features hip`):
   - `pub struct GpuLdpcBp { config: DecoderConfig, base_graph: H }`
     implementing `Stage<LlrBatch, HardDecisionBatch>`.
   - `cpu_fallback()` returns a CPU stage wrapping
     `gf2_coding::ldpc::core::LdpcDecoder`.
4. Byte-identity test (under `--features hip`) in
   `tests/gpu_ldpc_byte_identity.rs`:
   - For DVB-T2 r1/2 16-QAM, fixed seed, 200 frames at three SNRs:
     GPU hard-decision output equal to CPU `LdpcDecoder` output
     bit-for-bit, across MinSum, NormalizedMinSum(0.75), SumProduct.
5. Parallelism-pays receipt entry in
   `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/parallelism-receipts.md` (apples-to-apples,
   decode-vs-decode per amendment 2026-06-09a):
   - GPU LDPC BP decode throughput vs **single-thread CPU
     `LdpcDecoder` decode-stage** throughput (≥ 10×).
   - GPU LDPC BP decode throughput vs **CPU-24-thread `LdpcDecoder`
     decode-stage** throughput (≥ 3×). Resolves audit C2.
   - Record the full-frame `c0b1702d`/`3fcb7025` numbers for context
     only; they are NOT the gate divisor.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] GPU LDPC BP hard-decision output matches CPU `LdpcDecoder`
  bit-for-bit for DVB-T2 r1/2 16-QAM at fixed seed and 200 frames
  across MinSum, NormalizedMinSum(0.75), SumProduct.
- [hard] `parallelism-pays` gate (apples-to-apples, decode-vs-decode
  per amendment 2026-06-09a): receipt records
  - GPU decode throughput ≥ 10× single-thread CPU `LdpcDecoder`
    decode-stage throughput (measured in isolation, same config)
  - **AND** GPU decode throughput ≥ 3× CPU-24-thread `LdpcDecoder`
    decode-stage throughput.
  - The full-frame `c0b1702d`/`3fcb7025` baselines are context only.
- [hard] The flat `LdpcGraphLayout` is the standard-agnostic
  representation the kernel decodes (per amendment 2026-06-09b): the
  kernel decodes any expanded Tanner graph unchanged, so Phase E
  `23d3525f` can reuse the same kernel binary for 5G NR by
  host-expanding base graph + per-`i_LS` shift table into the flat
  layout. The full per-`i_LS` shift consumption + 5G NR GPU-vs-CPU
  byte-identity is a `[hard]` criterion on `23d3525f` (deferred there
  per the user decision; DVB-T2 has no lifting to exercise it here).
- [hard] `cpu_fallback()` returns the CPU decoder (wrapped as a
  `Stage`); integration verified by Phase B `ed575f15`.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, `parallelism-pays` gates green.

## Non-goals

- No 5G NR-specific tuning here (Phase E `23d3525f` does that,
  including the host-side base+shift→flat-layout expansion).
- No multi-GPU dispatch (epic non-goal).
- No floating-point f16 / mixed-precision (deferred per design-doc
  §10).
title: GPU LDPC belief-propagation batch decode kernel
